title: Ill-Considered Action
subtitle: Fateful Choices and the Wisdom of Folly
summary: Step into a world where every action—no matter how small—can tip the balance between fortune and disaster. In these timeless fables, quick judgments and ill-placed trust set the stage for suspense, irony, and hard-earned lessons. Discover what happens when the line between loyalty and suspicion blurs, and when desperate friends chase treasures with more at stake than gold.
